assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Congenital heart disease is an abnormal formation of the heart or blood vessels next to the heart.

assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: It has an incidence of 8 cases of every 1000 live birth worldwide.

assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: of which 25% have critical Congenital heart disease.

assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: The congenital heart disease represents approximately 4.5% of all neonatal deaths.

assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: The survival rate of patients with congenital heart disease will depend on the severity, time of diagnosis, and treatment.

assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Approximately 97% of babies born with a non-critical congenital heart disease have a life expectancy of one year of age,

assertions.subject: Congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: and approximately 95% are expected to live around 18 years of age.

assertions.subject: Interrupted aortic arch
assertions.quote: A rare type of congenital heart disease is an interrupted aortic arch (IAA), which affects approximately 1.5% of congenital heart disease patients.

assertions.subject: Interrupted aortic arch
assertions.quote: In an IAA, there is an anatomical and luminal disruption between the ascending and descending aorta.

assertions.subject: Interrupted aortic arch
assertions.quote: IAA is a ductus dependent lesion since this is the only way the blood flow can travel to places distal to the disruption.

assertions.subject: Interrupted aortic arch
assertions.quote: This lesion is present is approximately 73% of all cases.

assertions.subject: Interrupted aortic arch
assertions.quote: Due to this malalignment, there could be left ventricular outflow tract obstruction.
